content: Taking this medication after meals and increasing your fluid intake can help reduce the likelihood of side effects such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach upset. It is important to remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they have determined that the benefits to your health outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States or Canada and experience side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. Precautions: Before starting this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. If you are using the liquid form of this medication, be aware that it may contain sugar, so caution is advised if you have diabetes. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If your doctor has instructed you to take low-dose aspirin to prevent heart attacks or strokes (typically 81–162 milligrams daily), continue taking it unless otherwise directed by your doctor. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center immediately. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Lab Tests and Monitoring: Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from heat, light, and moisture. Do not freeze it or store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This summary does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
